ALASKA MEDICAID

Quinine Sulfate and Quinine Sulfate Powder

Capsule: Qualaquin® 324 mg

Preferred Medication:

NA

Non-Preferred Medication:
NA

INDICATION:

1. “Qualaquin® is indicated only for treatment of uncomplicated Plasmodium. falciparum
malaria.”!

CRITERIA FOR APPROVAL:

1. The patient is being treated for uncomplicated P. falciparum malaria.

CRITERIA CAUSING DENIAL:

1. The patient is being treated for any unapproved condition, such as; treatment of severe or
complicated malaria, prevention of malaria and treatment or prevention of nocturnal leg
1
cramps .

LENGTH OF AUTHORIZATION:

1. Approved criteria may be authorized for up to 60 days.

REFERENCES / FOOTNOTES:
